notes.title: UPDATE - Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX - Support for new DLC
notes.notes:
* Support for new DLC has been added. 

    * DLC 1 : Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX - Extra Mission: "VS ???"
        It's time for an eXtreme challenge!
        A new mission has been added that pits
        you against an incredibly powerful Blade.
        You may even get a small reward if
        you're victorious...

    * DLC 2 : Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX - Extra Song: "Raison d'être"
        Lola's got a new song & outfit!
        Rack up over 1000 Kudos to hear Lola's new single "Raison d'être"
        and see her new Idol Mode outfit by using the "Outfit Changer" ability.
        The song has also been added to the jukebox.

* An issue where text would not display properly on the save data selection screen when 
  many cleared save files where present in a certain language has been fixed.
* A line break error in the German language script has been fixed.
* An issue that caused Lola's voiced lines to not play correctly when Twin Shredder was 
  used while she was providing navigational assistance has been fixed.
* Typos have been fixed.
* Various issues relating to gameplay stability have been fixed.

* Added an option to force the game to start in window mode.

  [ Forces the game to start in windowed mode. ]
    1. Right-click on the game title under the Library in Steam and select Properties.
    2. Under the General tab click the Set launch options... button.
    3. Enter the launch options "-windowed" and click OK.
    4. Close the Properties window and launch the game.

notes.title: UPDATE - Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX
notes.notes:
The following languages have been added:
* French
* Italian
* German
* Spanish
* Portugese

In addition, the following bug fixes and adjustments were made.
* An issue where using Twin Shredder while Darkness Trigger was activated could cause the player to become immobile has been fixed.
* An issue where breaking Crimm's armor at the same time his SP Skill is activated could cause the game to freeze has been fixed.
* Boss collision hitboxes have been adjusted.
* Sound balance has been adjusted.
* Typos have been fixed.
* Various issues relating to gameplay stability have been fixed.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX
notes.notes: Fixed some graphic display bugs, such as an unnatural line display on the picture of some enemy characters.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where the game window might disappear from the taskbar if the game window was minimized while playing the game in full screen mode.
